list.title: Courses
list.description: Learn at your own pace — lesson by lesson.

detail.enrolledHint: All lessons are unlocked now. Start with the first one below.
detail.enrollFailedHint: The enrollment never arrived. Try again; if it keeps failing, reload the page.
detail.upgradeTitle: This course is part of Pro
detail.upgradeText: A Pro subscription unlocks all paid courses.
detail.paidUnavailableTitle: This course can't be booked right now
detail.paidUnavailableText: It is set up as a paid course, but this community has no way to take payments. Your best move is to ask whoever runs it.
detail.signInHint: Sign in to take part and unlock all lessons.
detail.notMember: This course is only for members of this community.
detail.notMemberHint: Anyone can see the preview. Only members can take part — ask the people running this community for an invitation.

lesson.failedHint: The lesson still counts as open. Click “Complete lesson” again.
lesson.notMemberHint: The lessons are for members only. The course overview shows you what the course offers.

admin.title: Courses
admin.empty: No courses yet — create the first one.
admin.createdHint: You are in the course builder now. The course is still a draft and nobody can see it — start by adding lessons.
admin.courseSaveFailedHint: The course was not created. Everything you typed is still in the form — please try again.
admin.statusFailedHint: The course status is unchanged. Reload the page and try again.

statusHint.published: The course is now in the public course list. Only published lessons show up inside it.
statusHint.draft: The course is unpublished and no longer listed. Enrolled participants keep their progress.
statusHint.archived: The course is archived and no longer listed. Enrolled participants keep their progress.

admin.lessonCreatedHint: The lesson is a draft. Publish it from the row menu so participants can see it.
admin.lessonSaveFailedHint: The lesson was not saved. Your text is still in the form — please try again.
admin.lessonPublishedHint: Participants can see it in the course from now on.
admin.lessonUnpublishedHint: Participants can no longer see it. The rest of the course is unchanged.
admin.lessonStatusFailedHint: The lesson status is unchanged. Reload the page and try again.
admin.lessonDeleteFailedHint: The lesson is still there. Reload the page and try again.
admin.reorderFailedHint: The order is unchanged. Please try again.
admin.slugTakenHint: Pick a different address — for example by adding something like “-2026” at the end.
admin.confirmDeleteLessonText: “{title}” will be deleted for good — including for participants who already read it.
admin.noLessons: No lessons yet — start with the first one.
admin.editingWarning: {name} is editing this course right now, too.

form.title: Title
form.slugHelp: The part after the slash (technical term: “slug”) — lowercase-with-dashes.
form.entitlementHelp: Unlock key from the subscription plan (e.g. paidCourses) — the app checks it on access.
form.videoHelp: External link (YouTube, Vimeo, …) — no video hosting.

validation.slugInvalid: Address: 3–100 chars, only a–z, 0–9 and dashes.
validation.paidNeedsProduct: Paid courses need an unlock key.
validation.translateLocaleInvalid: That is not a valid language code.
